Austin, Texas · In development

Food and beer, designed together.

NASHA is a future Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen. We are working out the food, the beer and the place in the open, before any of it exists.

NASHA is in development. There is no brewery, no restaurant, no truck and no menu for sale yet. Illustrations show a concept, not a built place.

01 What NASHA is

Two kitchens at one table.

India and Mexico both build flavour from chile, lime, toasted spice, flatbread and fermentation. NASHA starts from what they share, and lets each stay itself.

The food and the beer are specified together, so each is designed to make the other better. That is a design goal we intend to test, not a result we have.

09 A note on the name

About the word nasha.

It means intoxication or addiction in Hindi and Urdu. We chose it for the feeling of being captivated. We will never romanticise addiction or dangerous drinking, and cultural advisors will review the name before launch. The founder chose it; legal clearance is pending.

About NASHA

NASHA is a future Indo-Mex brewery and kitchen in Austin, Texas, in development.

The name was chosen by the founder. Legal clearance of the name is pending. Nothing here claims trademark ownership. There is no brewery, restaurant or truck open, and nothing is for sale.

In Hindi and Urdu, nasha means intoxication or addiction. We chose it for the feeling of being captivated by food and beer. We take that meaning seriously and will never present excess or addiction as something to admire. Cultural advisors will review the name and our language before launch.

Menu items are designs for testing, not served food. Heat levels and vegetarian labels describe how a dish is designed, not a certified allergen or dietary statement. Ask before you eat if you have an allergy. If you drink, drink responsibly. Alcohol is for adults of legal drinking age.

Illustrations on this site are original vector drawings made for this project. See how we track asset rights. Build of 2026-10-11.
